paragraphs.text: Homura (HOH-moo-rah) , Human Ascendant , was a human monk of Kamigawa from the time of the Kami War .

Homura was a legendary enlightened human monk whose meditations allowed him to grant the power of dragons to his allies. After ascending, Homura became become a powerful, legendary enchantment known as Homura's Essence that represented the focused essence of his mortal form similar to Incarnations .
